title: LatAm Synth — Transactions
description: Synthetic deposit and withdrawal transactions linked to savings goals and users. Generated by the LatAm Synth engine calibrated on 506K real LatAm records (2015-2024).

transaction_id.title: Transaction ID
transaction_id.description: UUID v4 identifier for the transaction

goal_id.title: Goal ID
goal_id.description: UUID of the savings goal this transaction belongs to

user_id.title: User ID
user_id.description: UUID of the user who owns the goal

date.title: Date
date.description: Date of the transaction (YYYY-MM-DD), always within [goal.created_at, goal.deadline]

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: Transaction amount in local currency units (always > 0)

transactions.title: Transactions
transactions.description: All synthetic transactions with date, type, amount and references to goal and user.
